doc.title: Lisa Parrott interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 22, 2021

title: Goodbyes and Men at Work video
summary: Closing thanks, a Men at Work parody video, and quarantine days remaining.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: All right. Well thank you for your time.
You’re welcome. Thanks for asking these questions. You obviously did a lot of research which is very flattering. But thank you very much, I really enjoyed this.

I wish you the best with your gigs down under. You know I was going to open — I’m so happy that I didn’t do this, I was going to open up like singing “The Land Down Under” from Men at Work. I said, no that’s too corny, don’t do that.
You are going to have to go onto YouTube though. I did do a Men at Work “Moo Can it Be Meow” Covid music video. I’m not kidding you.
And Colin Hay, the lead singer did a cameo in it, that’s a whole ‘nother story for another time.
Awesome. Well how many days do you have left before they allow you out?
This is my eighth day, so I’ve got another six days, yeah.
You’re past the halfway point I guess.
Well I hope we cross paths in the future in Brooklyn rather than in —
Yes I agree, that would be great.
